parsed.notes:
Minimum Qualifications is required; Preferred Qualifications is optional. The Unitree and humanoid experience in Who You Are is explicitly a strong plus.
Responsibilities and company-description technologies were excluded unless independently requested in qualifications. Responsibilities were used for seniority, as the guide permits lead-duty inference.
The explicit lead duty determines seniority rather than the lower 3+ years experience signal.
The highest degree named is PhD. The bachelor's route still requires a degree, so it does not establish experience in place of a degree.
Training or deploying learned policies was provisionally mapped to model-development and ai-deployment; these are alternative ways to meet the same ask, and both mappings are flagged for review.
Most robotics methods and platforms have no taxonomy entry and are listed in unmapped rather than mapped to unrelated AI skills. Technical dynamics and control methods were treated as technical skills, not industry-domain knowledge.
3D perception was provisionally mapped to computer-vision and flagged because the posting does not use that exact term.
Alternative sets involving unmapped skills include controller types; QP-based whole-body control, operational-space control or MPC; CAD tools; 3D printing or machining; imitation learning, RL or VLA; simulation ecosystems; and robotics middleware. No alternative_group numbers are emitted because these sets cannot be represented completely as taxonomy-backed criteria in the supplied output schema.
Open-source contributions were treated as a technical collaboration practice; publication venues were not treated as tools or skills. No German-language requirement appears.
